S1_ALIGNMENT_FAILED.meaning: One or more positioning sensors did not confirm correct seating/alignment of the two parts.
likely_causes: Part A or Part B not correctly seated
recommended_actions: Inspect both parts and verify correct seating.
Check the positioning fixture for obstruction or misalignment.
Check the three Station 1 positioning/alignment sensors.
Reposition the assembly and repeat the positioning operation.
If the fault repeats, inspect fixture and sensor alignment.
S1_ALIGNMENT_FAILED.repair_confirmation: All required Station 1 sensors must report OK before production continues.

S2_EARLY_TARGET_TORQUE.meaning: Target torque was reached before the required screw rotation was completed.
recommended_actions: Inspect the screw and thread for blockage or cross-threading.
Remove and inspect the screw.
Check the assembly position in the fastening fixture.
Inspect the fastening tool and bit.
Replace damaged screw/component if necessary.
Repeat the fastening operation and verify normal torque-angle behavior.
S2_EARLY_TARGET_TORQUE.repair_confirmation: Required rotation must be completed before target torque is reached.

S2_NO_SCREW_ENGAGEMENT.meaning: Screw engagement was not confirmed. Rotation occurred without the expected torque build-up or screw presence.
likely_causes: Screw feeder failed to deliver a screw
Screwdriver rotating without engaging the screw
Damaged screw head or tool bit
recommended_actions: Verify that a screw is present.
Inspect the screw feeder and delivery path.
Check screw positioning below the fastening tool.
Inspect the screwdriver bit for wear or damage.
Insert/replace the screw if required.
Repeat fastening and verify torque-angle behavior.
S2_NO_SCREW_ENGAGEMENT.repair_confirmation: Screw presence must be confirmed and the required torque-angle condition must be reached.

S2_PRODUCT_STUCK_NO_EXIT.meaning: The assembly did not reach the expected Station 2 exit sensor.
likely_causes: Fixture did not release the assembly
recommended_actions: Inspect Station 2 for a physically blocked assembly.
Check conveyor/transport movement.
Verify that the fastening fixture released the product.
Inspect the Station 2 exit sensor.
Remove any obstruction.
Manually verify that the transport path is clear before restarting.
S2_PRODUCT_STUCK_NO_EXIT.repair_confirmation: The assembly must leave Station 2 and trigger the expected exit signal.

S3_FINAL_INSPECTION_FAILED.meaning: At least one final inspection check returned NOK.
likely_causes: Product defect from an earlier station
recommended_actions: Identify which final inspection check is NOK.
Inspect the corresponding product feature.
Verify part presence and assembly position.
Verify the fastening result if relevant.
Inspect the affected inspection sensor.
Correct the product or sensor condition and repeat final inspection.
S3_FINAL_INSPECTION_FAILED.repair_confirmation: All six final inspection checks must report OK before the product is accepted.
